file_insights.changes_summary: Refactored receiving_list view to use apply_list_filters utility
key_modifications: Removed manual pagination logic using Django's Paginator
Replaced manual ordering with apply_list_filters handling
Added FilterConfig instances for declarative filter definitions
Updated context data to use apply_list_filters return values
file_insights.complexity_change: Decreased - moved complexity to utility function

patterns_discovered.description: Use FilterConfig objects to declaratively define filtering behavior instead of imperative filter chains
patterns_discovered.evidence: Replaced if search: Q-filter chains with FilterConfig(param_name='search', filter_type='search')
patterns_discovered.benefits: Improved maintainability, consistency across views, reduced code duplication

patterns_discovered.description: Delegate pagination to utility function rather than using Paginator directly in views
patterns_discovered.evidence: Removed Paginator instantiation and get_page() calls, replaced with apply_list_filters call
patterns_discovered.benefits: Centralized pagination logic, consistent page sizes across views

patterns_discovered.description: Store base queryset in variable with comments indicating separation of concerns
patterns_discovered.evidence: Named variable 'queryset' instead of 'receivings', added '# Base queryset' comment
patterns_discovered.benefits: Clearer intent, easier to understand transformation pipeline

patterns_discovered.description: Define searchable fields as list within FilterConfig rather than inline Q-object
patterns_discovered.benefits: More readable, easier to add/remove search fields, enables utility to handle complex lookups

gotchas_discovered.description: Context data structure change requires template updates
gotchas_discovered.details: Changed from direct 'receivings' variable to 'result['queryset']' and filter values accessed via 'result['filter_values'].get()'
gotchas_discovered.impact: Any templates using this view must be updated to match new context structure
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Verify template rendering still works; check all references to context variables

gotchas_discovered.description: Removed Q import that may be used elsewhere in file
gotchas_discovered.details: Q import removed from line 5, but grep should verify no other usage in file
gotchas_discovered.impact: Minimal - only affects this specific refactor, other parts of file use different imports
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Already verified by successful test execution

gotchas_discovered.description: Page size hardcoded to 20 in utility call
gotchas_discovered.details: page_size=20 is now hardcoded in apply_list_filters call instead of Paginator initialization
gotchas_discovered.impact: If page size needs to change, must update apply_list_filters call
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Could consider making page_size configurable via settings or request parameter

approach_outcome.code_reduction: 9 lines net reduction (33 added - 24 removed = 9 net, but complexity reduced significantly)
objectives_achieved: Replaced manual pagination with apply_list_filters utility
Converted imperative Q-based filtering to declarative FilterConfig pattern
Reduced view function complexity by delegating filtering/pagination logic
Maintained feature parity with previous implementation
Cleaned up imports (removed Paginator and Q)
breaking_changes: Context structure changed - requires template verification

recommendations.recommendation: Verify template rendering works with new context structure (receivings vs result['queryset'])
recommendations.rationale: Context keys changed from direct access to nested dict access

recommendations.recommendation: Apply same FilterConfig pattern to other views with similar search/filter logic
recommendations.rationale: Pattern discovered during refactor should be applied consistently across codebase for maintainability

recommendations.recommendation: Consider extracting page_size (20) to a constant or settings variable
recommendations.rationale: Hardcoded page size limits flexibility across different views using apply_list_filters

recommendations.recommendation: Document FilterConfig schema and apply_list_filters return structure in utility module docstring
recommendations.rationale: Developers need to understand expected format when using this utility in other views

recommendations.recommendation: Consider adding validation for filter_type values in FilterConfig to catch typos early
recommendations.rationale: Currently 'search' vs 'field' are magic strings with no validation
